2608.18575.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
2608.18575.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effective, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to long-context processing, expensive post-training and handcrafted workflows. Moreover, empirical evidence shows that even state-of-the-art models achieve limited accuracy on existing benchmarks, suggesting that scaling model size alone is insufficient. In this work, we revisit this task and question the necessity of such expensive generative solutions. We introduce AFANet, a lightweight graph-based framework that models interaction trajectories through step-level semantic signals and agent-level relationships. We show that with significantly fewer parameters and near-zero inference cost, AFANet (i) matches or outperforms LLM-based baselines, including fine-tuned models on in-domain benchmarks, (ii) maintains robust performance across different GNN architectures and (iii) can be further improved with inexpensive test-time adaptation on the OOD benchmark. Our results suggest that effective agent failure attribution does not require heavy LLM reasoning and a lightweight, structured approach can achieve strong performance.
2608.18575.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 基礎的多代理系統 (MAS) 通常會出現複雜的故障模式，這經常導致代理產生不正確的結果。這促使了代理故障歸因的任務：給定一個失敗的多代理軌跡，識別故障代理及其相應的錯誤類型。現有的方法主要依賴 LLM 來執行故障歸因，無論是通過直接提示、在合成數據上進行微調，還是複雜的代理管道。雖然這些方法有效，但由於長上下文處理、昂貴的後訓練和手工製作的工作流程，這些方法會產生相當大的計算開銷。此外，實證證據顯示，即使是最先進的模型在現有基準上也僅能達到有限的準確度，這表明僅僅擴大模型大小並不足夠。在這項工作中，我們重新審視這一任務，並質疑這些昂貴生成解決方案的必要性。我們引入了 AFANet，一種輕量級的基於圖的框架，通過步驟級的語義信號和代理級的關係來建模互動軌跡。我們表明，AFANet 在參數顯著減少和近乎零的推理成本下，(i) 與基於 LLM 的基準相匹配或超越，包括在領域內基準上微調的模型，(ii) 在不同的 GNN 架構中保持穩健的性能，並且 (iii) 可以通過在 OOD 基準上進行低成本的測試時間適應進一步改進。我們的結果表明，有效的代理故障歸因並不需要繁重的 LLM 推理，輕量級的結構化方法可以實現強大的性能。
